messages:
maria: FYI CloudWave (APAC marketplace) just sent an updated shipment plan — several POs moved out and one tranche was split across weeks. Not great for our Dedicated commit.
leo: ugh, which POs? can you paste the notes or manifest snippet?
maria: posted the carrier snippet below. PO IDs: CW-PO-4471, CW-PO-4472, CW-PO-4473. CW-PO-4472 is now split: 40% ETA 2026-09-15, 60% ETA 2026-09-29.
oliver: that split will materially affect our onboarding ramp for the EU region if we can't swap buffers. Do we have spare backlog inventory to cover the week-of-9/22?
sophia: two enterprise trials are expecting Dedicated capacity the week of 9/20 — if we miss that window sales will escalate. We need a temporary swap or a credit offer.\maria: CloudWave offered to try an earlier partial pickup from a nearby fulfillment center but it's not guaranteed. They asked if we want to reprioritize CW-PO-4473 earlier (would push another customer's shipment later).
leo: who owns customer communication for the trials? we should give 48h notice if we plan to change.
rahul: i'll take comms if we make a call today. need confirmation on whether we can realistically allocate from our US staging pool.
oliver: checking staging pool now. quick status: US pool has ~12 racks free, but kitting and firmware install backlog is ~5 days. So effectively we can free ~6 racks earlier by expediting ops ($$$).
\msophia: @sophia (typo) — suggestion: offer a partial capacity swap + one-month SLA credit if we can't meet full commit. Keeps customers calm.
maria: CloudWave also flagged lead-time recalcs across other partners for next quarter; they suggested we signal an updated reservation forecast to avoid re-splits.
leo: action items: 1) oliver confirm if 6 racks can be staged by 9/18 if we pay expedited labor, 2) maria confirm whether CloudWave can early-pick CW-PO-4473 for a fee, 3) rahul ready customer comms draft if we need to amend expected capacity.
oliver: running a quick ops lift estimate now. if we expedite, cost estimate =~ $18k and we can stage 6 racks by 9/17. I can commit to that if product agrees.
maria: CloudWave response: "can early-pick CW-PO-4473 for 30% of its freight cost and move CW-PO-4472 tranche 1 forward by 2 days if Redwood confirms asap."
sophia: given customer risk, i'd greenlight the early-pick if legal signs off on a one-off freight PO. please escalate to finance.
leo: tagging @finance in case they see this later — can we approve up to $25k one-off for expedited freight/labor to save the trials?
rahul: i'll draft a short, honest comms template: explain a staggered delivery and offer alternative test window + credit. will post within an hour once we lock decision.
orion-bot: calendar update: Tentative hold placed on 2026-09-18 for staging surge (ops-alert).
maria: decision: we approve expedited staging + accept CloudWave early-pick for CW-PO-4473. oliver please create an expedited work order and invoice to finance. rahul send comms after oliver confirms staging ETA.
oliver: creating work order now, WO-7832, will attach expidited labor line items. staging ETA 2026-09-17 EOD.
maria: thanks all. follow-ups: oliver to post WO and expected arrival manifest; rahul to post customer note; leo to update internal capacity dashboard and flag on-call routing for 9/18.
leo: will update dashboard and set an on-call rotation for staging issues.
rahul: comms draft posted: "Quick update — due to a partner shipment split, your Dedicated onboarding will be staged across two windows: initial activation week of 9/20, final capacity by 9/29. We can offer a pro-rated credit for any SLA gaps and a priority support line during the staging period. — Rahul"
sophia: that reads well. i'll prep the account teams.
maria: closing note: we should add a short-run policy with CloudWave to require 14-day firm notice on splits for critical commits. i'll draft a policy ask for the partnership team to negotiate.
leo: agreed. this is the third split incident this quarter. we need stronger marketplace SLOs or penalty terms.
maria: filing that in the partnerships backlog. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
